name: Ronz SLTP MT5
summary: This EA is a trade management utility that automatically applies Stop Loss and Take Profit to open positions, supports both server-side and client-side (hidden) SL/TP modes, and includes a lock-profit feature and three trailing stop methods. It does not open trades based on its own strategy signals; it only manages existing positions.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个交易管理工具，自动为已有持仓设置止损和止盈，支持服务端和客户端（隐性）止损止盈模式，并包含锁定利润功能和三种移动止损方法。它不根据自身策略信号开仓，仅管理已有持仓。
strategy_analysis: 该EA本身不产生交易信号，而是作为持仓管理工具运作。入场条件方面，EA不自行开仓，仅在OnInit中初始化参数，在OnTick中扫描所有持仓或当前图表品种的持仓。出场条件方面，Server模式下通过trade.PositionModify设置服务端SL/TP，Client模式下通过虚拟点数计算当盈利达到TP或亏损达到SL时调用trade.PositionClose平仓。仓位管理方面，EA不涉及开仓手数计算，但包含CheckMoneyForTrade和CheckVolumeValue方法用于OrderTest测试下单。资金管理方面，锁定利润功能在持仓盈利达到LockProfitAfter点数后将SL移至开仓价加ProfitLock点数处，保护已有利润。移动止损提供三种方式：经典跟随、步进保持距离、逐步移动，分别适应不同行情节奏。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA does not generate trading signals itself but operates as a position management utility. Regarding entry conditions, the EA does not open positions on its own; it only initializes parameters in OnInit and scans all open positions or current chart symbol positions in OnTick. For exit conditions, in Server mode it sets server-side SL/TP via trade.PositionModify, while in Client mode it calculates virtual point distances and closes positions via trade.PositionClose when profit reaches TP or loss reaches SL thresholds. Position sizing is not handled by the EA for real trading, though it includes CheckMoneyForTrade and CheckVolumeValue methods used only in the OrderTest tester function. Money management is embodied in the lock-profit feature, which moves the SL to the open price plus ProfitLock points once the position reaches LockProfitAfter points in profit, thereby protecting existing gains. The trailing stop offers three methods—classic trailing, step-distance keeping, and step-by-step incremental—each suited to different market rhythms and volatility conditions.

parameters.name: SLnTPMode
parameters.description: 止损止盈模式：服务端或客户端（隐性）

parameters.name: LockProfitEnable
parameters.description: 启用/禁用锁定利润功能

parameters.name: LockProfitAfter
parameters.description: 达到此点数后触发锁定利润
parameters.description_en: Profit lock triggers after reaching this many points

parameters.name: TrailingStopMethod
parameters.description: 移动止损方法：经典/步进保持距离/逐步移动

parameters.name: ChartSymbolSelection
parameters.description: 管理范围：仅当前图表或所有持仓
parameters.description_en: Scope: current chart only or all positions

parameters.name: inpEnableTest
parameters.description: 启用策略测试器自动下单测试

pros: 支持服务端和客户端两种止损止盈模式，灵活性高
提供三种移动止损方法，适应不同交易风格和市场节奏
锁定利润功能可在盈利达到目标后自动保护利润
代码结构清晰，使用面向对象封装AutoSLTP类
可选择仅管理当前图表品种或所有持仓，适用范围广
pros_en: Supports both server-side and client-side (hidden) SL/TP modes, offering high flexibility
Provides three trailing stop methods to suit different trading styles and market conditions
Lock-profit feature automatically protects gains once a profit target is reached
Clean code structure using OOP with the AutoSLTP class encapsulation
Configurable scope to manage current chart symbol only or all open positions
cons: Client模式下止损止盈依赖EA持续运行，EA关闭或断线后虚拟SL/TP将失效，风险极高
SetInstantSLTP函数返回值始终为false，虽然不影响功能但表明代码逻辑不够严谨
没有新K线检查机制，每个tick都遍历所有持仓并尝试修改，可能导致频繁无效的PositionModify调用
缺少对PositionModify失败原因的日志记录，不利于排查问题
LockProfit与TrailingStop之间的衔接逻辑（Poin在LPA和LPA+TS之间时）处理不够直观，容易造成混乱
cons_en: Client mode SL/TP depends on the EA running continuously; if EA stops or connection drops, virtual SL/TP becomes ineffective, posing significant risk
SetInstantSLTP always returns false, which while not breaking functionality indicates imprecise code logic
No new bar check mechanism; iterating all positions and attempting modifications every tick may cause frequent unnecessary PositionModify calls
No logging of PositionModify failure reasons, making troubleshooting difficult
The transition logic between LockProfit and TrailingStop (when Poin is between LPA and LPA+TS) is unintuitive and potentially confusing
improvements: 添加OnTick中的新K线检查，减少不必要的持仓遍历和修改调用频率
为Client模式添加断线保护机制，如EA卸载时自动为所有虚拟止损止盈持仓设置服务端止损止盈
记录PositionModify和PositionClose的失败原因及错误码，便于调试和监控
improvements_en: Add new bar check in OnTick to reduce unnecessary position iteration and modification call frequency
Implement disconnect protection for Client mode, such as auto-setting server-side SL/TP for all virtually managed positions on EA deinitialization
Log PositionModify and PositionClose failure reasons with error codes for debugging and monitoring

risk_points: Client模式（隐性止损止盈）下EA停止运行则止损止盈完全失效，持仓将无保护暴露于市场风险中
每个tick都执行遍历和修改操作，在高频行情下可能导致交易服务器过载或被限制
缺少对minstoplevel变化的动态校验，止损止盈可能在市场波动时因违反止损级别要求而被拒绝
risk_points_en: Client (hidden) SL/TP mode leaves positions completely unprotected if the EA stops running, exposing them to unlimited market risk
Position iteration and modification on every tick may overload the trade server or trigger rate limits during volatile markets
No dynamic validation of minstoplevel changes; SL/TP modifications may be rejected for violating stop level requirements during market volatility

It does not open trades based on its own strategy signals; it only manages existing positions.
